ValidationRule.description: Require core classification fields for operational alert cases.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $RecordType.Name = 'Operational Alert', OR( ISBLANK(AccountId), ISBLANK(TEXT(CareOrch_Alert_Source__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(CareOrch_Severity__c)) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Operational Alert cases require Account, Alert Source, and Severity.
